ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Federal Child Care Funding Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the use of federal child care funding nationwide and identify potential schemes similar to Feeding Our Future.
questions: How much federal child care funding is allocated to each state?
What are the regulations and oversight mechanisms in place to prevent misuse of funds?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and misuse of federal funds. By analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and trends that may indicate similar schemes in other states.
